# M12 zero-price route selected for a full-run trial

The selected trial route is `openrouter/stealth/space-bunny-alpha`, pinned to OpenRouter's `Stealth` provider with fallbacks disabled. This selects a route for the public end-to-end trial; it does not establish that the research graph completes or that the model meets scientific-quality criteria. The owner waived retention and training restrictions for public campaign inputs on 2026-09-27. Zero additional spending and the existing safety and scientific gates remain in force.

## Evidence and decision

- OpenRouter's [current model listing](https://openrouter.ai/stealth/space-bunny-alpha) describes text output, tools, JSON-object output, a large context window, and a free route. Its [endpoint metadata](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/stealth/space-bunny-alpha/endpoints) listed one Stealth host with prompt and completion rates of `0` at selection time. The model ID has no `:free` suffix, so admission handles only this exact promotional ID and rechecks the live catalog before every campaign request.
- The [one-call actual-interface receipt](m12-space-bunny-smoke-2026-09-27.json) records fresh admission, a Stealth-only request, the requested model served, 392 prompt and 16 completion tokens, valid structured JSON, zero retries, and $0.00 reported cost. It is a compatibility smoke, not full-run evidence. The isolated express trial is run `5edffdcc-aac9-4ea2-b722-a1986dce3cca`; its outcome belongs under M12-02b2.
- The code rejects nonzero listed rates and conditional overrides before transport. The OpenRouter routing block limits prompt and completion prices to zero, requires parameters, pins Stealth, and disables provider fallback. The `request: 0` field is also sent, but [OpenRouter's published guidance](https://openrouter.ai/blog/tutorials/how-to-get-the-lowest-cost-llm-inference-on-openrouter/) documents `max_price` for token prices only; it is not asserted as a guaranteed fixed-fee cap. Actual cost must be verified from the run's provider usage and account receipt.
- Existing BYOK requests remain distinct outside campaign mode. A fresh-context read-only review found no critical flaw in the exact route pin or token-price gate. Required local checks passed on this diff: `make test-all`, `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make build`, `make eval-smoke`, frontend `bun run test` (803/803), and `make e2e` (18/18). The first concurrent frontend attempt had one timing failure; the affected test and full frontend suite passed on rerun without code changes. An earlier `make test-all` attempt crossed a routing-source edit during an evaluation identity check; the clean rerun after edits passed.

## Alternatives and limits

Gemma 4 31B's one capped application JSON call returned an upstream 429 and was not retried. The Groq GPT-OSS 120B route had earlier interface compatibility but an 8,000-token/minute free ceiling and an inconclusive scientific result; its direct adapter is no longer part of the product. Other current free listings either lacked a needed declared feature, had lower observed availability, or were near a published retirement. Space Bunny has one advertised host and no demonstrated completed research run yet. If the trial fails or reports a charge, it is not a qualified route and M12-02b2 remains open.
